text: Why is BGP a path vector protocol rather than distance vector or link state?
choices: Path vector is faster to compute
Carrying the full AS path allows loop detection without trusting anyone — a router discards any advertisement containing its own AS number
It was the only option available in 1989
explanation: In an environment of conflicting interests and absent trust you cannot assume neighbours are honest or even correct. Recognising your own name in a path requires no trust and no global view, which is exactly what an inter-domain protocol needs.
